visual.title: p fixes the focus and the latus rectum
visual.caption: The standard form x² = 4py puts the focus at (0, p), the directrix at y = -p and the latus rectum, the chord through the focus parallel to the directrix, at length 4p. Here p = 1, so the focus is (0, 1), the directrix is y = -1 and the latus rectum is 4 units long.

predict.question: For x² = 4py, how long is the latus rectum?
predict.explain: The chord through the focus has endpoints (2p, p) and (-2p, p), because x² = 4p·p gives x = ±2p. Its length is 4p.

label: The latus rectum
subgoals: Connect p to the chord length
